title: Make every interlocking structural residual explicit, narrow, and bound to an acceptance and validator

facts.note: Planning task mentions an interlocking or residuals. Source subject_kind is interlocking: the subject is an interlocking wherever it lives (standalone or embedded in another planning artifact); no file classification is assumed.

values: interlocking subject authored, edited, or validated that has a structural residual (declared or relied on but not declared)
facts.note: Subject-level detection of interlockings (including embedded ones) and of residuals that are relied on but not written down cannot be read from a declaration list; absence of residual declarations is not evidence of absence of residuals. Needs LLM judgement until a subject-level interlocking/residual observer exists.
Source validation phase is CONFIRM with confirm-blocking enforcement; covers every structural residual of the interlocking, changed or not. Phase tracking needs an observer.
Validator finding from the sequence-diagram sanity test.

fires: CONFIRM validates an interlocking subject (standalone or embedded in another planning artifact) that has structural residuals, including residuals not changed in this work.
A planner authors or edits an interlocking that relies on a structural residual which is not written down as a residual.
A structural residual in an interlocking lacks an acceptance reference or a validator reference.
A structural residual is vague or broad rather than narrow.
doesNotFire: An interlocking that has no structural residual at all, neither declared nor relied on implicitly (an empty residual declaration alone does not establish this).
Planning artifacts that contain no interlocking subject.

given: An interlocking subject (standalone or embedded) that has one or more structural residuals, whether declared or relied on without being written down.
when: The planner authors or edits the interlocking, or the interlocking is validated at CONFIRM.
then: Make each structural residual explicit and narrow, and bind it to both an acceptance reference and a validator reference.
prefer: Write each residual down with its own residual id, stating the one structural gap it covers.
Bind each residual to a concrete acceptance_ref and validator_ref that resolve to an existing acceptance and validator.
avoid: Leaving a structural residual implicit: relying on it without writing it down as a residual.
Broad residuals that cover several unrelated gaps.
Missing, placeholder, or dangling acceptance_ref or validator_ref added just to satisfy the presence check.
why: A structural residual is the escape hatch from surfacing something directly; it stays safe only if it is explicit, narrow, and still covered by an acceptance and a validator.
evidence: Each residual of the interlocking has a residual id, an acceptance_ref and a validator_ref; on failure, report interlocking_id, residual_id, acceptance_ref, validator_ref and reason.
verifier_detail: Validation family: presence; template: conditional_requirement; variant: planner_train_interlocking_structural_residual_explicit.
Condition: a structural residual is present in the interlocking; requirement: the residual is explicit and narrow and has both an acceptance ref and a validator ref.
Phase CONFIRM, enforcement confirm-blocking; subject_kind interlocking (subject-level, not tied to a file kind). Applies to all residuals of the interlocking, not only changed ones.
Failure evidence fields: interlocking_id, residual_id, acceptance_ref, validator_ref, reason.
audit: term_id: residual_explicit — structural residuals are explicit and narrow and bound to an acceptance and a validator

additions.text: Own residual id per residual, one gap per residual.
additions.justification: Operationalises 'explicit and narrow' and the residual_id failure-evidence field for the planner audience.

additions.text: acceptance_ref and validator_ref must resolve to an existing acceptance and validator (concrete refs).
additions.justification: Operationalises 'bound to an acceptance and validator'; a ref that resolves to nothing is not a binding. No further proof criterion is added.

additions.text: Placeholder/dangling refs to game the presence check; broad residuals.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming and breadth anti-patterns that are the negations of 'bound' and 'narrow'; required by authoring rules.

additions.text: Implicit residual defined as one relied on but not written down.
additions.justification: Negation of 'explicit'; deliberately does not claim that every unmentioned gap is a residual.
Taken from graph.json edge reason (requires planner.train.interlocking-wmbt-surface-or-residual); source has no explicit rationale.

additions.text: Authoring/editing trigger besides CONFIRM; subject-level interlocking detection incl. embedded interlockings; implicit residuals in scope.
additions.justification: Lets the planner apply the rule while writing and avoids narrowing activation to declared residuals or a file classification; CONFIRM remains the source trigger.
